facts.text: Report: India Justice Report (IJR) 2025, initiated by Sir Dorabji Tata Trust — police, judiciary, prisons, legal aid
facts.head: News

facts.text: Police: ⚠ 22% women personnel — highest in India; projected 33% (with Bihar) in 3 years; 5.2% women officers
facts.head: AP highlights

facts.text: Prisons: spending ₹2.6 lakh per inmate a year (₹733/day) — highest; national average ₹44,110 (2022–23)
facts.head: AP highlights

facts.text: Prison doctors shortfall: only 5% — lowest; Telangana highest at 59%
facts.head: AP highlights

facts.text: Judiciary: women 16.7% in HC, 50.9% in subordinate courts; judges per 10 lakh — 10.5 (subordinate), 1.8 (HC); vacancies HC 19%, district courts 12%
facts.head: AP highlights

facts.text: Legal aid: women — panel lawyers 20.7%, PLVs 33.6%, DLSAs 50%
facts.head: AP highlights
